svg.text: PANELS 01–03 · PROPERTIES OF BPUT'S OWN NUMBERING
DASHED LINE = THEIL–SEN MEDIAN OF PAIRWISE SLOPES
Coverage has a real denominator because the universe was measured: 160,609 registration numbers
across 1,103 college-and-year ranges. Reads spent is arithmetic rather than a model, and an
observation is one student-semester, never a person: the registration number is dropped first.
PANELS 04–11 · TRAFFIC THIS DEPLOYMENT ACTUALLY SERVED
ONE ANONYMOUS ROW PER SUCCESSFUL LOOKUP
QUIET IS A READING, NOT A ZERO
